access_profiles.description: The home page displays entry/login state. Authentication mode and enabled-user checks decide whether the app can be entered.
Visible after app entry: an enabled session in authenticated mode, or configured authentication bypass. Client-only panels do not imply permission to use protected service APIs.

App entry plus backing service checks: when FRACTO_AUTH_REQUIRED=true, enabled-user or internal-service authentication is required; mutations also validate the configured UI origin. Individual endpoints can impose stricter roles.
Backed by administrative endpoints that require a current enabled administrator session. App navigation alone does not grant that access.
Administrative endpoints normally require an enabled administrator. Explicit FRACTO_ADMIN_READONLY_BYPASS with auth mode none can open only the registered read-only GET views.
Requires an enabled administrator, or explicit FRACTO_ADMIN_CHAT_LAB_BYPASS with auth mode none and auth not required. The configured UI origin and server-held AI credential remain required.
Data-query reads follow the service authorization policy; the users table adds an administrator check. This catalog contains table descriptions, never actual records.

features.purpose: Inspect server health, roles and local labels; preview and synchronize databases or mesh files with a trusted peer, choosing which server keeps conflicting rows or meshes.
inputs: Database or mesh sync preview and conflict server preference
limitations: Saved labels and addresses are browser-local preferences; public health does not grant administrative access.

Database sync requires identical migration history and table definitions, excludes tiles and automation, and temporarily locks included tables. Conflicting rows require an explicit server preference; invalid references block application.

Mesh sync shares validated gzip mesh assets only, requires matching source identities and mesh profiles, pauses mesh generation during each operation, and leaves numerical tiles, databases and local inventory journals untouched. Both servers need the sync code and trusted peer configuration.
Anonymous labs can explicitly opt in to sync access using FRACTO_ADMIN_SYNC_LAB_BYPASS; the exact configured UI origin is required, and other administrator routes remain protected.

features.purpose: Choose General chat for model replies with text-file attachments, or App reference for exact cited passages from the published app guide. Replies stream with Stop cancellation; switching modes starts a new conversation.
inputs: UTF-8 TXT, Markdown, JSON and CSV attachments
limitations: At most four files, 4096 bytes each, within an 8192-byte serialized message context budget.

App reference accepts a standalone question of at most 512 characters, 1024 UTF-8 bytes and 12 keywords, without files; it requires a published bundle and an enabled evaluated app-reference skill and performs no model calls or live checks.
Validated build bundles automatically seed at startup and refresh every minute unless FRACTO_AI_APP_REFERENCE_REFRESH is false. Operator-owned publications, edits and retirements are preserved.
PDFs, images, persistent transcripts and action execution are not implemented.
Model availability, memory and disk admission can block generation; replies can be incomplete after interruption.
